N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

rate_no_record.long_name: Proportion of students with no immunization record on file
rate_no_record.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students for whom no immunization record was on file.
rate_no_record.long_description: Share of assessed school students with no immunization record at all, which is distinct from having an incomplete record or an exemption.
rate_no_record.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had no immunization record on file.

rate_personal_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
rate_personal_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
rate_personal_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
rate_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_religious_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious vaccination exemption
rate_religious_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_religious_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption. Reported by states that separate religious exemptions from other non-medical (philosophical or personal-belief) exemptions.
rate_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

rate_mmr.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination
rate_mmr.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination.
rate_mmr.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.

nd_school_immunization.name: North Dakota School Immunization Coverage
nd_school_immunization.organization: North Dakota Health and Human Services
nd_school_immunization.description: School- and county-level immunization coverage, incompletion, and exemption data from the ND HHS coverage-rate reports, reported per grade cohort (Kindergarten, 7th, 11th/12th). County rows are derived as an enrollment-weighted mean of that county's school rates, since ND HHS does not publish county-level figures directly. Rates are blanked (NA) at the school level for small enrollment counts (mostly enrollment under 6), consistent with the state's small-cell suppression practice for student privacy.
nd_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
